hypotheses.hypothesis: The Draft terminal was caused by truncated output.
hypotheses.evidence: All three responses were end_turn, sentence-closed and within the configured Han range.
hypotheses.falsification: Produce a hash-bound receipt showing a truncation finish reason or incomplete boundary for one of calls 20-22.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scope retry modified content outside its allowed scope.
hypotheses.evidence: The current scope owns the whole Draft unit and supplies no edit span or immutable prose; whole regeneration is allowed.
hypotheses.falsification: Produce an exact contract field that limits retry to a smaller prose span.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The retries failed to remove the target leaf issue.
hypotheses.evidence: Concrete issue counts were 6, 7 and 1; the third result remained blocked.
hypotheses.falsification: Replay call 22 under the same validator version and obtain zero blocking matches.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Repairing A introduced a new blocking B that was not rechecked.
hypotheses.evidence: No secondary deterministic blocker was observed; narrative semantic validation was not reached, so semantic B remains unknown.
hypotheses.falsification: Bind a new call-21/22 blocker or semantic receipt to the exact output hash.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The deterministic prose validator has a false positive or over-strict rule.
hypotheses.evidence: The same regex classifies a known corrupted name and an upstream-approved Latin term identically; punctuation alone changes the outcome.
hypotheses.falsification: Show that the matched token was not authority-approved or that the current regex consults approved terminology.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A stale Draft, Manifest or Receipt was validated.
hypotheses.evidence: The leaf gate validates the exact current returned Draft object and its regex signature does not read Manifest or Receipt state.
hypotheses.falsification: Demonstrate object substitution between _stage return and _draft_segment_findings.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Best-candidate selection chose the wrong Draft.
hypotheses.evidence: No Draft candidate or segment checkpoint existed; candidate selection was never reached.
hypotheses.falsification: Produce a run-bound Draft candidate row or protected best-candidate artifact.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recovery Policy should have contained the least-blocked output.
hypotheses.evidence: Call 22 was diagnostically least blocked but was not a legal candidate; containment would alter acceptance/checkpoint semantics.
hypotheses.falsification: Identify an existing policy path that legally seals and resumes a locally rejected stage output.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Output-budget loss caused the Draft failure.
hypotheses.evidence: Call 22 reported 4096 output tokens but finished end_turn, exceeded minimum length, closed its sentence and failed on a deterministic term match.
hypotheses.falsification: Show that the blocking matched token or terminal disappears solely when the same output receives a larger budget.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The incident is only random model quality with no stable code defect.
hypotheses.evidence: A stable regex and sanitized minimal counterexample reproduce the rejection deterministically.
hypotheses.falsification: Demonstrate non-deterministic results for the same text and validator build.
